## this course – aims and basic introduction

what is this course about?

::: incremental
-   introduction to the `inlabru` toolbox

-   the philosophy and concepts behind `inlabru`

-   the scope of `inlabru` – showcase
:::

:::: fragment
at the end of this course you will:

::: incremental
-   know basic and increasingly complex syntax structure that you can build on

-   have an idea of

    -   what types of basic and increasingly complex models can be fitted with `inlabru`

    -   where to start if you want to fit your own complex models in `inlabru`
:::
::::
